verdict.rationale: Unleash docs directly describe segments as reusable collections of strategy constraints, plus custom activation strategies/targeting and attribute-based rules for flag rollout (unleash-docs-9, unleash-docs-17, unleash-docs-18). This directly matches the story's request for attribute-based rules and reusable segments to target specific user variations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of complex multi-attribute rule evaluation and the HN comment noting relative rule-system limitations versus competitors introduces some doubt but is not a concrete contradiction.
